not_read: existing Jonah chunks or campaign state

evidence_only_guard: Hebrew morphology, syntax, Masoretic accentuation, paragraphing, poetic layout, repeated lexemes, wordplay, discourse formulae, translation difficulty, versification, ancient-version wording, and internal biblical relations are boundary evidence only. They select no preferred reading, witness, punctuation, speaker, referent, plant species, setting, date, genre-history, source direction, identity, miracle explanation, ethics, fulfillment, canon, or theology. Roots are not meanings; phrase, clause, scene, book, and canonical context control lexical observations. Agreement is evidence, never authority.
macro_parent_alternatives: Jonah.1.1-Jonah.1.16 may remain one commission-flight-storm-sea parent.
Jonah.1.17-Jonah.2.10 may remain one fish-prayer-deliverance parent despite the English chapter seam and MT versification displacement.
Jonah.2.2-Jonah.2.9 may remain one indivisible psalmic prayer; inner movements are evidence-bearing subunits, not source claims.
Jonah.3.1-Jonah.3.10 may remain one recommission-proclamation-response parent.
Jonah.3.5-Jonah.3.10 may remain one Nineveh-response parent joining public response, royal decree, and divine response.
Jonah.4.5-Jonah.4.11 may remain one east-of-city scene culminating in the final contrastive question.
The mirrored Jonah.1.1-Jonah.1.3 and Jonah.3.1-Jonah.3.4 commissions are noncontiguous correspondences, not one chunk.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Wayhi debar-YHWH, qum lekh, qera, and great-city language establish commission; wayyaqam libroach and repeated yarad narrate the counter-journey.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No motive beyond narrated flight, divine-presence ontology, setting, date, historicity, authorship, or source-history ruling.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: YHWH hurls wind, sailors hurl cargo, Jonah asks to be hurled, and sailors hurl him; storm, fear, calling, questions, prayer, cessation, sacrifice, and vows form a chain.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No causality model, moral verdict, conversion claim, deity comparison, innocent-blood ruling, or preferred nautical rendering.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: English versification places fish appointment at 1:17 and prayer introduction at 2:1; MT-based Hebrew witnesses number these 2:1-2:2. Fish gender forms vary within the frame.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: Keep English coordinates; no witness preference, gender significance, species, chronology, miracle, or composition ruling.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Poetry moves through distress/answer, Sheol, seas/waves, banishment/temple, waters/deep, descent/ascent, remembrance/prayer, hebel-shaw, hesed, vow, thanksgiving, and salvation; clause division and aspect affect movements.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No source-psalm reconstruction, prayer chronology, death-state ontology, temple dating, quotation direction, cultic theory, or preferred punctuation.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: The wording around 'yet I will again look' bears assertion/interrogative pressure; waters/deep/descent reach a nadir before 'you brought up my life.'
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No preferred punctuation, emendation, ancient-version reading, psychology, or doctrine.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Meshammerim havle-shaw and chasdam yaazovu are lexically and pronominally difficult; wa-ani, sacrifice, vow, and yeshuatah la-YHWH close the prayer.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No referent, idol-theology, hesed-ownership, sacrificial chronology, or preferred syntax decision.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Shenit, repeated qum lekh/qera, matching wayyaqam wayyelekh, lelohim city idiom, travel measures, and nehpakhah carry recommission/proclamation. MT has forty days at 3:4; Greek tradition prominently attests three.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No preferred numeral/witness, city-size reconstruction, itinerary, chronology, or overthrow/turning theology.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Belief, fast, sackcloth, greatest-to-least, throne-to-ashes, decree, human/animal pairing, cry/turn, mi-yodea, shuv, nacham, and raah span public, royal, and divine response.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No regime identity, repentance system, animal-practice reconstruction, divine-mutability doctrine, preferred disaster/evil gloss, or historical ruling.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Raah names evil way, threatened disaster, and Jonah's great evil/displeasure; shuv and nacham connect decree, divine response, and Jonah's confession.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: Preserve wordplay without collapsing clauses or deciding divine attributes, moral equivalence, intertext direction, or theology.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Wayyera el-Yonah raah gedolah, anger, repeated ki, gracious/merciful formula, death request, and hahetev charah-lakh create complaint/counter-question.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No psychological diagnosis, moral verdict, Exodus/Joel direction, doctrinal system, death-wish evaluation, or preferred idiom.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Exit/sitting/seeing resets the scene; wayman repeats for plant, worm, and east wind amid shade, gladness, withering, heat, fainting, death request, and repeated anger question. Qiqayon and harishit are difficult.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No plant species, mechanism, meteorology, rare-word preference, psychology, or ethical verdict.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Attah chasta contrasts with wa-ani lo achus; labor/growth, night/night, great city, right/left, human multitude, and animals extend one final rhetorical question.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No population reconstruction, age/capacity referent, animal-theology inference, historicity ruling, or supplied answer.

global_holds.witnesses: OSHB and UXLC expose the same broad Masoretic/Leningrad substrate and are not independent ancient votes. Masoretic manuscripts, Greek Twelve, Judean-desert fragments where extant, Syriac, Vulgate, Targum, and later witnesses expose pressure but establish no preferred reading, numeral, punctuation, versification, or direction.
global_holds.versification: English 1:17-2:10 differs from MT-based numbering that places fish appointment at 2:1 and continues through 2:11. Required English coordinates are retained; displacement is evidence only.
global_holds.commission_mirror: Jonah.1.1-Jonah.1.3 and Jonah.3.1-Jonah.3.4 share word-coming, arise/go, Nineveh/great-city, and proclaim language; first flight and second going sharpen the mirror without deciding history, psychology, composition, or theology.
global_holds.descent_ascent: Yarad marks movement down to Joppa, ship, recesses, and mountain roots; divine raising from the pit reverses the sequence. This is phrase/book evidence only.
global_holds.prepared_agents: Wayman links fish, plant, worm, and wind across Jonah.1.17 and Jonah.4.6-Jonah.4.8; repetition supports cohesion but decides no mechanism, symbolism, species, genre-history, or theology.
global_holds.sea_scene_word_chains: Hurling, sea/storm, great, fear, calling, perishing, and cessation recur through Jonah.1.4-Jonah.1.16; seams are movements inside one larger chain.
global_holds.raah_shuv_nacham: Evil/disaster/displeasure, turning, and relenting language binds Jonah.3.8-Jonah.4.2. Contextual distinctions and wordplay remain without root-fallacy or doctrinal conclusion.
global_holds.speech_and_speakers: Narrator, YHWH, Jonah, captain, sailors, king/nobles, Ninevites, and quoted communal voices are local observations; quotation scope, collective voice, addressees, and rhetoric remain open.
global_holds.poetry: Jonah.2.2-Jonah.2.9 is embedded poetic prayer within prose framing. Parallelism, address shifts, spatial images, and vow/thanksgiving close support movements but authorize no source separation.
global_holds.internal_relations: Exodus 34, Psalms, Joel, other Twelve passages, Kings' Jonah notice, Gospel reuse, and broader sea/Sheol/temple/repentance relations are evidence only; no relation creates a seam, decides direction, identifies fulfillment, or supplies missing answers.
global_holds.genre_history_ethics_theology: Narrative, satire, parable-like effects, prophetic story, prayer, miracle, repentance, judgment, mercy, anger, violence, death wishes, divine action, historicity, fulfillment, and doctrine remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.
global_holds.confidence_policy: Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai because this is a same-model blind primary with unresolved textual and translation hot zones.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayhi debar-YHWH and qum lekh/qera open commission; wayyaqam libroach shifts to refusal, and repeated yarad/millifne YHWH carries the counter-movement to embarkation.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split commission from Jonah's response, or merge storm into departure.
proposed_chunks.risk: Commission formula, motive, presence idiom, geography, chapter-3 mirror.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Commission and matching response form expectation/reversal; destination closes departure before YHWH hurls wind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Storm crisis, sailors' response, and captain's summons
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wa-YHWH hetil opens a scene; storm/ship-breaking, fear/cry/cargo-hurling, Jonah's sleep, and captain's imperative form the first crisis movement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate storm, each cry, cargo, sleep, or captain speech.
proposed_chunks.risk: Nautical syntax, causality, deity language, sleep.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hurling/fear start the sea chain; captain's qum qera answers commission imperatives before lot-casting.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Lot decision, interrogation, confession, and intensified fear
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Lekhu wenappilah goral initiates diagnosis; lot, question catalogue, Jonah's answer, yirah gedolah, and 'what is this?' complete discovery.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split lot, questions, confession, and fear.
proposed_chunks.risk: Providence, identities, fear object, question limits.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Cause-of-evil wording links lot and interrogation; response and narrator explanation close discovery.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Sea-calming deliberation, failed rowing, prayer, casting, cessation, and vows
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Mah-naaseh opens solution; answer, rowing, prayer, action, sea cessation, great fear, sacrifice, and vows resolve the storm.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each action, or attach fish appointment.
proposed_chunks.risk: Innocent blood, responsibility, divine action, worship.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Holekh wesoer prompts yishtoq; failed rowing heightens prayer/action, and wayyaamod plus fear/vows closes.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Fish appointment and prose prayer frame
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayman YHWH appoints fish and temporal enclosure; Jonah's prayer introduction frames the poem.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach 1:17 to sailors, isolate either verse, or absorb poem/expulsion.
proposed_chunks.risk: English/MT versification, fish gender, chronology, genre.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: MT-based sources number these 2:1-2:2, a versification not content seam; appointment/introduction form ingress.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Poetic opening: distress answered, sea descent, and temple-facing tension
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyomer starts poetry; qara/ana and shiwwati/shamata parallel distress/answer, ki gives sea account, wa-ani amarti turns to banishment/temple.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize verses or let punctuation alone split 2:4.
proposed_chunks.risk: Aspect, Sheol, Psalmic reuse, assertion/interrogative pressure.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Distress/answer controls prayer; sea images explain distress and first-person turn gives close.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Poetic descent climax and ascent reversal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Waters/deep/weeds intensify enclosure; mountain roots and earth bars reach nadir before wattal mishshahat hayyay reverses upward.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split water/mountain imagery, or isolate ascent.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Enclosure/descent accumulate; adversative ascent completes the movement.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Poetic remembrance, contrast, vow, thanksgiving, and salvation close
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Behitatef opens remembrance; idol/hesed language gives contrast, and wa-ani with sacrifice, vow, and yeshuatah la-YHWH forms cadence.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate remembrance, difficult saying, vow, thanksgiving, or acclamation.
proposed_chunks.risk: Pronouns, hesed, cultic chronology, insertion theory.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Prayer-to-temple recalls opening; contrastive syntax drives to vow/acclamation.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyomer YHWH returns to narration; address to fish and expulsion onto dry land close the frame.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach to poem, or carry into recommission.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person poem switches to third-person narration; dry land completes sea descent.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Renewed commission, obedient journey, and city proclamation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayhi debar-YHWH...shenit restarts; qum lekh/qera is answered by wayyaqam wayyelekh, then entry/proclamation.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split commission/response, isolate travel notes, or detach proclamation.
proposed_chunks.risk: City idiom, travel measures, numeral variant, nehpakhah.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Lexical mirror and shenit mark restart; proclamation completes commissioned action.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Citywide response, royal abasement, decree, and contingent hope
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyaaminu opens response; fast/sackcloth spread, word reaches king, throne yields to ashes, decree culminates in mi-yodea/'not perish.'
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split popular/royal response, atomize commands, or isolate 'who knows?'.
proposed_chunks.risk: Royal titles, animal practice, repentance, relenting.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Response escalates populace-to-ruler-to-collective action; repeated fast/sackcloth/cry/turn/perish unifies.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Narrated divine response to Nineveh's turning
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyar ha-Elohim shifts from decree to narrator; saw/deeds/turned and relented/disaster/not-do give outcome/hinge.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach to decree or merge with Jonah's displeasure.
proposed_chunks.risk: Single verse, raah gloss, relenting theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Narrative voice distinguishes outcome; raah/nacham feeds following reaction.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Jonah's displeasure-prayer-death request and divine counter-question
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyera...raah gedolah opens reaction; wayyitpallel starts complaint, and YHWH's hahetev question closes exchange.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split reaction, confession, death request, question, or merge east-city action.
proposed_chunks.risk: Raah, character formula, psychology, anger, death wish.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Prayer explains reaction and ends in death request; question answers anger and sets 4:9 pattern.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: East-of-city watch, prepared-agent object lesson, death wish, and repeated anger question
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyetze resets place/action; booth/shade/seeing leads into wayman for plant, worm, wind, then death wish and repeated hahetev question/answer.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate booth, each agent, death wish, or dialogue.
proposed_chunks.risk: Chronology, qiqayon, harishit, divine names, anger.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Watching city establishes goal; agents manipulate shade/exposure in one chain and plant question closes.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Final contrastive divine speech and unanswered rhetorical question
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wayyomer YHWH begins answer; attah chasta contrasts with wa-ani lo achus, expanding plant/night to Nineveh, humans, right/left, animals.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split plant/city comparison, infer answer, or merge all prepared-agent action.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Second/first-person contrast and great-city language create final comparison; interrogative remains unresolved.
